We can do one of two things quickly:

- Option B: Apply a one-time token credit (to be used within the existing pilot window) — my initial thought is 5,000 tokens as a starting proposal.

A couple of operational notes: if you go with the extension, we’ll push a short addendum that extends the pilot end-date (no pricing change). If you want credits instead we can apply them immediately to reduce burn.

I’m looping in David (finance) and Grace (customer success) to confirm the internal approval path — David, Grace, any constraints on approving a 7-day extension vs a 5k token credit for a customer at this stage?
